deviation_mechanism: Broadband thin-film performance depends on coherent phase accumulation across the target band, which requires controlled optical thickness ratios. The executed designs exhibit extreme thickness dispersion; for instance, the fourth candidate array shows Layer 1 at 1778.4169569563137 nm juxtaposed with Layer 8 at 227.32723686587383 nm (a >7.8× ratio). This widens the optical path difference distribution, breaking the constructive interference condition needed for uniform transmission and instead exciting narrow-band resonance dips. The optimizer's push toward divergent thicknesses degraded the global objective despite higher layer count flexibility.
